    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts={v:[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==v and x!=bg] for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v!=bg}
    for color, p in pts.items():
        if len(p)!=2: continue
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=p
        dr,dc=r2-r1,c2-c1
        if abs(dr)!=abs(dc) or dr==0: continue
        # Continue the diagonal ray beyond the second point.
        sr=1 if dr>0 else -1; sc=1 if dc>0 else -1
        r,c=r2+sr,c2+sc
        while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=color
            r+=sr;c+=sc
    return out
